name: Yellow is a Lonely Color
source:
Back then, you could only hold onto death and eventually became death itself—but now you want to understand life. That's why you stayed with Oda Sakunosuke. 

However, you certainly didn’t expect to meet a boy so similar yet so different from you. It’s funny how everything seems fated now.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=52704]lemmasoft forum[/url]]
